cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - GridfinityBase
cc:Work.dc:description: A parameterized Gridfinity base This is a configurable gridfinity base. This design is based on Zach Freedman's Gridfinity system Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes GridfinityBase --x 5 --y 4 --size_x 220 --size_y 175 --panel_x 100 --panel_y 100 --h 20 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes GridfinityBase --x --y --size_x --size_y --panel_x --panel_y --h --reference --labels
